title: Unequal-Width 4-Corner Mixture (4.3x Scale Spread)
intuition: Four equal-mass corner Gaussians with distinct widths sigma in {0.07, 0.12, 0.20, 0.30}. Probes Law 3A (W1 ray-length identifiability): the trainer must match each cluster's individual width without smearing narrow clusters or shrinking broad ones.
failure_mode: Unit-slope W1/Lipschitz critics exert width-independent pull, collapsing wide clusters or letting stray samples contaminate the narrowest sigma=0.07 mode.
protocol_notes: Tier-2 held transfer-vector task (1,200 updates, clean live evaluation).
